data.name: Naqeel
data.gender_notes: Naqeel is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'an-Naqil', meaning 'the eagle'. In Islamic tradition, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) was given the title 'An-Naqeel' due to his ability to soar above the mundane world and bring guidance to humanity. The name Naqeel carries the meaning “Eagle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naqeel usually hope their child will grow to embody eagle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes courage, strength, and the ability to rise above challenges.
data.etymology: Naqeel belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Eagle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naqeel total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: نَقيل
in_arabic.meaning: نَقيل يعني الشخص الذي ينقل أو يروي الحديث
in_arabic.long_meaning: نَقيل هو اسم مشتق من الجذر النقلي، وهو يعني الشخص الذي ينقل أو يروي الحديث، أو الشخص الذي يتمتع بمهارة في نقل الأخبار والقصص. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم هذا الاسم للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يتمتع بمهارة في نقل الحديث والقصص، وغالبًا ما يُستخدم في سياق الرواية والحديث النبوي.

in_urdu.name: نقیِل
in_urdu.meaning: نقیِل کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو حديث یا خبر نقل کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: نقیِل ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو حديث یا خبر نقل کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام نقل کے جذر سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے نقل کرنا یا روایت کرنا۔ اردو میں، یہ نام ان افراد کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو روایات اور اقوال نقل کرنے میں مہارت رکھتے ہیں، خاص طور پر اسلامی متن اور تاریخی واقعات کے حوالے سے۔

in_hindi.name: नकील
in_hindi.meaning: नकील का अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो कथा या समाचार को आगे बढ़ाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: नकील एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो कथा या समाचार को आगे बढ़ाता है। यह नाम नकल के मूल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है किसी और की बात या कथा को दोहराना। देवनागरी में, यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो कथाओं और इतिहास को संजोने और आगे बढ़ाने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाते हैं, खासकर इस्लामी परंपरा में।

in_pashto.name: نقییل
in_pashto.meaning: نقییل دى هغه کسانو لپاره چې حديث یا خبره نقل کوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: نقییل د عربي نوم څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې دى هغه کسانو لپاره چې حديث یا خبره نقل کوي. دا نوم د نقل څخه راغلی دی، چې معنی یې د بل چا خبره یا حدیث نقل کول دي. په پښتو کې، دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي چې په احادیثو او تاریخي پېښو کی مہارت لري، او د هغو کسانو لپاره چې د پښتو قومي دودیزو ارزښتونو ته ارزښت ورکوي.

in_english.name: Naqeel
in_english.meaning: Naqeel means a person who conveys or narrates a story or hadith
in_english.long_meaning: Naqeel is an Arabic name derived from the root 'n-q-l', which means to convey, narrate, or transfer. In Islamic tradition, Naqeel refers to a person skilled in narrating hadiths, stories, or historical events. The name implies a sense of reliability and expertise in conveying information, reflecting the importance of oral tradition and accurate reporting in Islamic scholarship. Historically, individuals with this name were often respected for their knowledge and ability to share it with others.

pronunciation.hindi: नकील का उच्चारण नाह कील है
pronunciation.pashto: د نقییل تلفظ دى ناه کیل

data.cultural_impact: The name Naqeel holds a rich cultural significance in the Islamic world, where eagles are often seen as symbols of strength, wisdom, and nobility. The name may evoke images of soaring height, swiftness, and courage, all of which are celebrated in Islamic literature and folklore.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Naqeel is a reminder of the importance of soaring above the transient world and seeking knowledge and guidance from the divine. Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is described as a model for all Muslims, and the name Naqeel honors his ability to rise above the mundane and bring guidance to humanity, much like the powerful and majestic flight of an eagle. Thus, the name Naqeel inspires individuals to seek wisdom, strength, and nobility in their own lives, striving to follow in the footsteps of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and soar above the distractions and challenges of the world.
